name: Video player
summary: A video frame over the film's still, with a big play button, a seek bar that shows what has loaded, skip back and forward, elapsed and total time, captions, mute and volume, and full screen; while it plays, the controls fade away until the pointer comes back.
use: on a watch page or in a lesson, for playing one video
a11y: Seek and volume are native range inputs, and seek reads its time in words; play, captions and mute say their state, and the controls never hide while focus is inside them, on touch screens or with reduced motion.

use_when: a recorded talk or event replay, where captions and skipping back matter
avoid_when: audio only, such as a song or podcast: use music-player or podcast-episodes
choosing what to watch from many titles: use media-shelf
a title's page with seasons and cast before playing: use title-detail

parts.name: poster
parts.what: the film's still behind the controls

parts.name: big_play
parts.what: the large play button in the middle, hidden while playing

parts.name: caption
parts.what: the current caption line over the picture

parts.name: seek
parts.what: a seek bar showing played and loaded parts

parts.name: skip
parts.what: back and forward 10 seconds, hidden on phones

parts.name: tag
parts.what: a small label such as CC and the quality

parts.name: summary
parts.what: one or two sentences on the video

empty.how: with no video yet, keep the frame and poster and replace the big play button with a short line such as 'Available Friday'

loading.how: the seek bar already shows what has loaded; while waiting for data, swap the big play button for a spinner and keep the controls

error.how: if the video cannot play, hide the controls and show an alert-banners line over the poster with a retry

disabled.how: set disabled on the skip buttons and the seek bar for a live stream that cannot be scrubbed

overflow.how: in a narrow box the frame becomes 4:3 and the skip buttons and volume slider go, leaving room for the rest

long_text.how: a long caption wraps with each line on its own backing; the time and tag never wrap; the title wraps

keyboard: Tab reaches the big play button, the seek bar, Play, Back 10 seconds, Forward 10 seconds, Mute, Volume, Captions, then Full screen
Enter or Space on Play or the big play button starts or pauses; the big button hands focus to Play
Arrow keys on the seek bar move it one second at a time and on the volume slider one step at a time, as with any native range
Enter or Space on Mute, Captions or Full screen switches them
while focus is inside the player the controls stay visible; there are no single-key shortcuts
